title: 2025年上海马拉松赛交通管制通告
claims: Traffic control for the 2025 Shanghai Marathon runs from 23:00 on 29 November to 13:30 on 30 November 2025.

From 06:45 to 13:30 on 30 November, the marathon route runs: Zhongshan East 1st Road - Zhongshan East 2nd Road - Xinkaihe Road - Renmin Road - Henan South Road - Henan Middle Road - Nanjing East Road - Hubei Road - Jiujiang Road - Nanjing West Road - Huashan Road - Changshu Road - Huaihai Middle Road - Madang Road - Xingye Road - Huangpi South Road - Zizhong Road - Jinan Road - Hubin Road - Huangpi South Road - Huaihai Middle Road - Xizang South Road - Gaoxiong Road - Zhizaoju Road - Longhua East Road - Bansongyuan Road (turnaround at Huayuangang Road) - Bansongyuan Road - Miaojiang Road - Bansongyuan Road - Lujiabang Road - Waima Road - Huangpu Riverside Promenade - Longhua East Road - Furun Road - Jiangbin Road - Ruining Road - Longteng Avenue (turnaround at Jinmugang Road) - Longteng Avenue - Fenggu Road (turnaround at Yunjin Road) - Fenggu Road - Longteng Avenue - Longheng East Road - Wanping South Road - Longhua Road - Longhua West Road - Zhongshan South 2nd Road - Shanghai Stadium Gate 12 (finish).

Roads around the start, including sections of Nanjing East Road, Jiujiang Road and Zhongshan East 1st Road, are closed from 23:00 on 29 November to 08:00 on 30 November; Zhongshan East 1st Road is closed to vehicles from 04:30 to 08:00.
Some bus routes sharing the course will be suspended, shortened or diverted.
The police may advance, delay, expand or reduce traffic control according to conditions on the ground.

claimVerification.note: 通告时间跨度为 11 月 29 日 23 时至 30 日 13:30。
第九条路线逐段与 claim 一致（花园港路、进木港路、云锦路折返，上海体育场 12 号门终点）。
第一条规定南京东路、九江路等 23:00–8:00；第三条中山东一路 4:30–8:00 禁车。
末段：同线路公交停驶、缩线、绕道。
末段：公安可提前或推迟、扩大或缩小管制。
